name: kb_marksmanship_hunter
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's marksmanship raid list: Aimed Shot on a Lock and Load proc and on cooldown, Arcane Shot, Steady Shot as the loop, Serpent Sting when the raid wants the armour debuff, Multi-Shot and Volley on packs, Rapid Fire, Feign Death and the two aspects. The swing timer (Auto Shot and the 0.5 s rule) is not a condition: the file does not start Auto Shot itself (kb.unexpressed).

rows.text: Keep Auto Shot running; never start a cast in the last 0.5 s before an auto | always [[d:hunter#1471459155179995167]]
rows.unexpressed: swing timer not in the conditions (the file does not start Auto Shot: the rotation format has no action for an auto-repeat spell)

rows.text: Aimed Shot | Lock and Load buff up (10 s, -1 s cast)
Arcane Shot | Enchanted (Arcane) Ammunition up AND the Aimed Shot has already landed (cast after the next Steady) [[d:hunter#1484610058904928467]], [[d:hunter#1485089214046539917]]
rows.unexpressed: weapon type not in the conditions (the ammunition); "after the next Steady, once Aimed has landed" is not a condition

rows.text: Steady Shot | after each Auto Shot, if it will not clip

entries.note: Moved after the AoE entries: the filler has no cooldown, so as a rule it would starve every entry the KB lists after it.

rows.unexpressed: swing timer not in the conditions

rows.text: Arcane Shot | after Steady if it fits without clipping, or while moving (crit roll for Lock and Load) [[d:hunter#1488527231008641095]]
rows.unexpressed: swing timer not in the conditions (the "after Steady if it fits" part)

rows.text: Serpent Sting | only if the raid wants the Nature Ammunition -240 armor debuff [[d:hunter#1488876111252160624]]
rows.unexpressed: raid assignment/marking (whether the raid wants the armour debuff: the KB casts the sting only when it does); weapon type not in the conditions (Nature Ammunition)

rows.text: skip Multi-Shot | single target: cannot proc Lock and Load; Fire ammo explosion bugged ~50 dmg [[d:hunter#1486698734736642089]], [[d:hunter#1484664003497300118]]
rows.unexpressed: the AoE entry casts Multi-Shot only on 2+ targets, which is the single-target skip

rows.text: Multi-Shot when it fits; spend Fire Ammunition on it
rows.unexpressed: swing timer not in the conditions; weapon type not in the conditions (Fire Ammunition)

rows.text: Volley opener (1 s cast with Barrage 3/3), Multi-Shot, then Lock and Load Aimed Shot down a line of mobs
rows.unexpressed: positional (a line of mobs) not in the conditions; swing timer not in the conditions

rows.text: Rapid Fire | on pull / with Bloodlust; also -40% Aimed/Steady cast; shares category with Juju Flurry [[d:hunter#1489692709550817407]], [[d:hunter#1489794704836137140]]
rows.unexpressed: consumable or item (combat_consumables owns items) (Juju Flurry shares its category)

rows.text: On-use trinkets | Badge of the Swarmguard + Jom Gabbar opener, then swap to Heart of Hakkar + Slayer's Crest [[d:hunter#1482615147359895697]]
Feign Death | threat drop (MM rips threat without cooldowns); Improved Feign Death mandatory [[d:hunter#1486215019384541225]], [[d:hunter#1484218976014831677]]
rows.unexpressed: the Improved Feign Death talent is not a condition

rows.text: Aspect of the Viper | Hawk until low mana, then Viper to the end of the fight; Viper ticks generate threat [[d:hunter#1478128745838674021]], [[d:hunter#1491714117369724928]]

entries.note: 20% is the number the shipped hunter uses for the switch to Viper.
60% is the number the shipped hunter uses for the switch back to the Hawk.

rows.unexpressed: "Viper to the end of the fight" is not a condition; the threat of Viper's ticks is not a condition

rows.text: ZG Renataki trinket | trash; resets Volley [[d:hunter#1484688430268022955]]
